proposals.title: Write ADR-002, ADR-004, and ADR-009 before any packages/core implementation
proposals.why_now: The spec explicitly requires ADR-009 written and the CanonicalEncoder implemented before any StateHash exists (FASE-1 acceptance criterion). ADR-002 must specify the hash function bit-by-bit before rand() is written. ADR-004's rounding-mode enforcement mechanism is DEFINIR and must be resolved before the divInt helper is typed. Implementing packages/core without these ADRs embeds unrecorded decisions that cannot be reversed without bumping encodingVersion and invalidating all frozen reference StateHashes. No ADRs currently exist in docs/decisions/.

proposals.title: Register transcendental-function contradiction and tools/* edge gap in SPEC_BLOCKERS.md
proposals.why_now: Section 5.1 constructs prices in log-space requiring Math.log and Math.exp; §13 prohibits both in all pure packages including packages/world. This is a spec contradiction that §19 requires to be registered before packages/world can be written — any implementation without a registered ADR embeds an unrecorded decision and violates §13 lint. Separately, §14.5 defines directed edges for packages/ and apps/ but not for tools/; tools/replay and tools/bench require cross-workspace imports to fulfill FASE-1 acceptance criteria. Both blockers are currently unregistered, meaning the implementation agent has no record of them and could silently resolve either by importing forbidden functions or by inventing tool dependency edges.

proposals.title: Implement packages/core: branded numeric types, positional RNG, division helpers, and CanonicalEncoder
proposals.why_now: packages/core is the sole dependency of every other pure package. Without branded Money/Quantity/Price/Rate bigint types and Tick/index safe-integer number types, ADR-003 and ADR-004 have no enforcement and violations accumulate from the first file in any dependent package. Without rand() implementing ADR-002 bit-exactly, packages/world cannot be written. Without CanonicalEncoder implementing ADR-009, no StateHash can be computed and INV-01, INV-17, INV-22 have no foundation. This is the second foundational implementation step and it unblocks all other packages simultaneously.

proposals.title: Implement packages/world (2-octave price generator), packages/domain (ledger + market orders), and packages/application (canonical tick loop + save)
proposals.why_now: These three packages compose the functional core required for FASE-1 acceptance. The price generator delivers INV-02. The double-entry multi-commodity ledger delivers INV-04 through INV-07. The canonical 10-step tick loop from §7 is explicitly listed in FASE-1 scope. The save structure per ADR-006 enables CLI replay. None of these invariants are verifiable in isolation — they become testable only when composed through application, the layer that legally couples world and domain without a direct package import between them. The transcendental-function blocker (IDEA-002) must be registered and resolved by ADR before packages/world can proceed.

proposals.title: Wire Electron simulation worker with typed IPC and produce minimum installer for Windows and Linux
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance criteria explicitly require: (1) simulation already running in a dedicated worker outside the rendering thread with a typed message contract; (2) a minimum installer for Windows and Linux produced by CI. The spec notes this is a sequencing trap: if the installer appears after the feature work, ABI issues, native module recompilation, and platform path bugs surface in the last week when there is no time to fix architecture. An installer that opens an empty window in FASE-1 is worth more than a perfect installer in FASE-7. INV-29 requires contextIsolation, nodeIntegration off, sandbox on in all execution modes including development — this must be validated by CI from the start.
